Then |MN|^2=(9/4)(t^2-t^{-2})^2+9(t+t^{-1})^2. Let u=t^2+t^{-2}>=2. This simplifies to |MN|^2=(9/4)(u+2)^2, so |MN|=(3/2)(u+2)>=6. Equality occurs at t=±1, e.g. M=(-3/2,-3), N=(-3/2,3). Thus the minimum value is 6. If M=N were allowed, the trivial minimum would be 0.
